A decorative horizontal band follows verse 20, then a separate Ars amatoria title and text. These establish the boundary; the unrelated work and its bottom catchword Sed are not imported into the poem. Full-page starts checked including the enlarged initial and exceptional second-verse inset. Original annotation rectangles preserved.
